#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, random, shutil, subprocess, sys

REF = "/tmp/refprog"
WORK = "/tmp/fuzzwork"
ACC, BOOK, TRAN, INP = 34, 28, 22, 22

IDS = [b"U001", b"U002", b"U003", b"U004", b"U005"]
BIDS = [b"B001", b"B002", b"B003", b"B004"]
NAMES = [b"John Doe", b"Jane Smith", b"Bob Wilson", b"Al", b""]

def pad(b, n):
    return (b + b" " * n)[:n]

def rnd_num10(rng):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.7:
        return b"%010d" % rng.randint(0, 9999999999)
    if r < 0.8:
        return bytes(rng.choice(b" 0A9+-,./:;\x00\xffZ") for _ in range(10))
    if r < 0.9:
        return bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(10))
    return b"0" * 10

def rnd_rec_acc(rng):
    aid = rng.choice(IDS) if rng.random() < 0.9 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
    return aid + pad(rng.choice(NAMES), 20) + rnd_num10(rng)

def rnd_rec_book(rng):
    bid = rng.choice(BIDS) if rng.random() < 0.9 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
    own = rng.choice(IDS) if rng.random() < 0.95 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
    return bid + pad(rng.choice(NAMES), 20) + own

def gen_case(rng):
    accs = b"".join(rnd_rec_acc(rng) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 4)))
    bks = b"".join(rnd_rec_book(rng) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 4)))
    trans = b"".join(b"B00%d%010dU001U002" % (rng.randint(1, 9), rng.randint(0, 99)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 3)))
    # optionally partial trailing records
    if accs and rng.random() < 0.25:
        accs += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, ACC - 1)))
    if bks and rng.random() < 0.25:
        bks += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, BOOK - 1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.25:
        trans += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, TRAN - 1)))
    # input
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.08:
        inp = b""
    else:
        buyer = rng.choice(IDS) if rng.random() < 0.85 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
        seller = rng.choice(IDS) if rng.random() < 0.85 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
        book = rng.choice(BIDS) if rng.random() < 0.85 else bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(4))
        amount = rnd_num10(rng)
        inp = buyer + seller + book + amount
        if rng.random() < 0.35:
            inp = inp[: rng.randint(0, INP - 1)]
        elif rng.random() < 0.15:
            inp += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 5)))
    return accs, bks, trans, inp

def setup(d, accs, bks, trans, inp):
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(d + "/src"); os.makedirs(d + "/data")
    open(d + "/src/INPUT.DAT", "wb").write(inp)
    open(d + "/data/ACCOUNTS.DAT", "wb").write(accs)
    open(d + "/data/BOOKS.DAT", "wb").write(bks)
    open(d + "/data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT", "wb").write(trans)

def run(cmd, cwd):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def files(d):
    out = {}
    for n in ("ACCOUNTS.DAT", "BOOKS.DAT", "TRANSACTIONS.DAT"):
        p = d + "/data/" + n
        out[n] = open(p, "rb").read() if os.path.exists(p) else None
    return out

def main():
    rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1234)
    n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 100
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(WORK)
    shutil.copy("/workspace/src/program.cbl", WORK + "/p.cbl")
    subprocess.run(["cobc", "-x", "-o", REF, WORK + "/p.cbl"], check=True)
    bad = 0
    for i in range(n):
        accs, bks, trans, inp = gen_case(rng)
        dc, dp = WORK + "/c", WORK + "/p"
        setup(dc, accs, bks, trans, inp); setup(dp, accs, bks, trans, inp)
        shutil.copy("/workspace/program.py", dp + "/program.py")
        rc_c, out_c, err_c = run([REF], dc)
        rc_p, out_p, err_p = run([sys.executable, "program.py"], dp)
        fc, fp = files(dc), files(dp)
        ok = (rc_c == rc_p) and (out_c == out_p) and (fc == fp)
        if not ok:
            bad += 1
            print("=" * 70)
            print("MISMATCH case", i)
            print(" in accs=%r\n bks=%r\n trans=%r\n inp=%r" % (accs, bks, trans, inp))
            print(" rc cob=%r py=%r" % (rc_c, rc_p))
            print(" stdout cob=%r py=%r" % (out_c, out_p))
            for k in fc:
                if fc[k] != fp[k]:
                    print("  %s:\n    cob=%r\n    py =%r" % (k, fc[k], fp[k]))
            if bad >= 8:
                print("stopping after 8 mismatches"); break
    print("done: %d cases, %d mismatches" % (n, bad))

main()
PYEOF

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, random, shutil, subprocess, sys

REF = "/tmp/refprog2"
WORK = "/tmp/fuzzwork2"
ACC, BOOK, TRAN, INP = 34, 28, 22, 22

def pad(b, n): return (b + b" " * n)[:n]
def num10(rng):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.75: return b"%010d" % rng.randint(0, 9999999999)
    if r < 0.85: return bytes(rng.choice(b" 0A9+-,./:;\x00\xffZ") for _ in range(10))
    if r < 0.95: return bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(10))
    return b"0" * 10

def acc_rec(aid, name, bal): return aid + pad(name, 20) + bal
def book_rec(bid, title, own): return bid + pad(title, 20) + own
def tran_rec(bid, amt, seller, buyer): return bid + amt + seller + buyer

def gen_structured(rng):
    """Valid transaction skeleton, then random mutations."""
    ids = [b"U001", b"U002", b"U003", b"U004"]
    bids = [b"B001", b"B002", b"B003"]
    buyer = rng.choice(ids); seller = rng.choice(ids); book = rng.choice(bids)
    accounts = [acc_rec(i, rng.choice([b"John Doe", b"Jane Smith", b"Bob Wilson", b""]), num10(rng)) for i in ids]
    books = [book_rec(b, rng.choice([b"Python Basics", b"COBOL Guide", b""]), rng.choice(ids)) for b in bids]
    # force valid ownership sometimes
    if rng.random() < 0.85:
        idx = bids.index(book)
        books[idx] = book_rec(book, b"COBOL Guide", seller)
    amount = num10(rng)
    rng.shuffle(accounts); rng.shuffle(books)
    # random extra/duplicate records
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 2)):
        accounts.insert(rng.randint(0, len(accounts)), acc_rec(rng.choice(ids), b"Dup", num10(rng)))
    for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 2)):
        books.insert(rng.randint(0, len(books)), book_rec(rng.choice(bids), b"Dup", rng.choice(ids)))
    trans = [tran_rec(b"B001", b"0000000010", b"U001", b"U002") for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 2))]
    a = b"".join(accounts); b = b"".join(books); t = b"".join(trans)
    inp = buyer + seller + book + amount
    # mutations
    if rng.random() < 0.1: a = a[: rng.randint(0, len(a))]
    if rng.random() < 0.1: b = b[: rng.randint(0, len(b))]
    if rng.random() < 0.1: t = t[: rng.randint(0, len(t))]
    if rng.random() < 0.12: a += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, ACC-1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.12: b += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, BOOK-1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.12: t += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, TRAN-1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.15: inp = inp[: rng.randint(0, INP-1)]
    elif rng.random() < 0.1: inp += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)))
    if rng.random() < 0.03: inp = b""
    return a, b, t, inp

def gen_chaos(rng):
    ids = [b"U001", b"U002", b"\x00\x00\x00\x00", b"    ", b"\xff\xff\xff\xff", b"U00A"]
    bids = [b"B001", b"B002", b"\x00\x00\x00\x00", b"    ", b"B00\xff"]
    accounts = [acc_rec(rng.choice(ids), rng.choice([b"", b"n", b"Name Here"]), num10(rng)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5))]
    books = [book_rec(rng.choice(bids), b"t", rng.choice(ids)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 5))]
    trans = [tran_rec(rng.choice(bids), num10(rng), rng.choice(ids), rng.choice(ids)) for _ in range(rng.randint(0, 2))]
    a = b"".join(accounts); b = b"".join(books); t = b"".join(trans)
    if rng.random() < 0.3: a += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, ACC-1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.3: b += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, BOOK-1)))
    if rng.random() < 0.3: t += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, TRAN-1)))
    inp = rng.choice(ids) + rng.choice(ids) + rng.choice(bids) + num10(rng)
    if rng.random() < 0.4: inp = inp[: rng.randint(0, INP-1)]
    elif rng.random() < 0.2: inp += bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)))
    if rng.random() < 0.05: inp = b""
    return a, b, t, inp

def setup(d, accs, bks, trans, inp):
    shutil.rmtree(d, ignore_errors=True)
    os.makedirs(d + "/src"); os.makedirs(d + "/data")
    open(d + "/src/INPUT.DAT", "wb").write(inp)
    open(d + "/data/ACCOUNTS.DAT", "wb").write(accs)
    open(d + "/data/BOOKS.DAT", "wb").write(bks)
    open(d + "/data/TRANSACTIONS.DAT", "wb").write(trans)

def run(cmd, cwd):
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def files(d):
    out = {}
    for n in ("ACCOUNTS.DAT", "BOOKS.DAT", "TRANSACTIONS.DAT"):
        p = d + "/data/" + n
        out[n] = open(p, "rb").read() if os.path.exists(p) else None
    return out

def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]); n = int(sys.argv[2])
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs(WORK)
    shutil.copy("/workspace/src/program.cbl", WORK + "/p.cbl")
    subprocess.run(["cobc", "-x", "-o", REF, WORK + "/p.cbl"], check=True)
    bad = 0; ok_cnt = 0; fail_cnt = 0; aborts = 0
    for i in range(n):
        gen = gen_structured if rng.random() < 0.6 else gen_chaos
        accs, bks, trans, inp = gen(rng)
        dc, dp = WORK + "/c", WORK + "/p"
        setup(dc, accs, bks, trans, inp); setup(dp, accs, bks, trans, inp)
        shutil.copy("/workspace/program.py", dp + "/program.py")
        rc_c, out_c, err_c = run([REF], dc)
        rc_p, out_p, err_p = run([sys.executable, "program.py"], dp)
        fc, fp = files(dc), files(dp)
        if rc_c == 0: ok_cnt += 1
        if b"failed" in out_c: fail_cnt += 1
        if rc_c != 0: aborts += 1
        if not ((rc_c == rc_p) and (out_c == out_p) and (fc == fp)):
            bad += 1
            print("=" * 70); print("MISMATCH case", i)
            print(" accs=%r\n bks=%r\n trans=%r\n inp=%r" % (accs, bks, trans, inp))
            print(" rc cob=%r py=%r  stdout cob=%r py=%r" % (rc_c, rc_p, out_c, out_p))
            for k in fc:
                if fc[k] != fp[k]:
                    print("  %s:\n    cob=%r\n    py =%r" % (k, fc[k], fp[k]))
            if bad >= 6: print("stop"); break
    print("done: %d cases, %d mismatch | rc0=%d failed-msg=%d aborts=%d" % (n, bad, ok_cnt, fail_cnt, aborts))

main()
